**Correction — console pin in the Environment line.**

This run's Environment line says vendored console `6314e87f`. That is the **repo-root `.objectui-sha`** (updated 2026-08-11 06:35) — the pin `main` wants. The bundle the server actually **served** during this run is `packages/console/dist/.objectui-sha` = **`09987b680d53801c79f67d969b14e9bb732b8a22`** (built 2026-08-10 09:58). Root and dist disagree because dist has not been rebuilt against the newer pin.

**Nothing in this run's verdicts changes.** The one console-lane finding here — `console-global-search`'s narrower recall — was located in **framework** source (`metadata-protocol` `searchAll` building its own filter instead of calling `resolveSearchFields`/`expandSearchToFilter`), not console source, and the palette behaviour was observed live against the running bundle either way.

Flagging it because anyone reproducing a console-lane finding should check out `09987b680`, not `6314e87f`. The two `.objectui-sha` files disagreeing is itself worth knowing about.

## Extraction ledger — COMPLETE. Closing.

Every FAIL, PARTIAL and checklist-maintenance item extracted; all three code defects re-verified live on `origin/main`, zero duplicates.

| Run item | Finding | Card | Lane |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `cross-field-object-search` c2 (FAIL) | `$search` is **case-sensitive** on textual fields, contrary to three declarations — `fieldClausesForTerm` emits `$contains` (case-sensitive per #4706 Q2=A; #6518 `LIKE`→`GLOB` removed SQLite's incidental fold); `$icontains` matches | #7641 | `domain:engine-core` |
| `field-scoped-narrowing` c2(B) (FAIL) | the `__search` companion column, declared client-invisible, is echoed in every record body — no read path strips it from the default projection | #7642 | `domain:engine-core` |
| `console-global-search` c2 (PARTIAL) | ⌘K palette recall strictly narrower than the executor — `metadata-protocol` `searchAll` builds its own filter, never ORs the companion field, stale `$contains` comment | #7643 | `domain:metadata` |
| Checklist maintenance ×3 | case-insensitive declared in 3 places vs case-sensitive behaviour; `pinyin-flag-both-sides` oracle unobtainable; `rls-both-personas` fixture 8→12 | #7647 | `domain:devx` |

The 2 PASS items produced no cards.

### #7641 carries a decision, flagged not buried

`$search` case-sensitivity is a real behaviour-vs-contract break, but the *direction* of the fix is a maintainer call: **(A)** make `$search` emit `$icontains` so behaviour matches the three existing declarations (recommended in the card — search is near-universally expected case-insensitive, and three places already declare it so), or **(B)** change the declarations to say case-sensitive. Whichever way #4706 Q2 finally lands, the three declarations (item title, `search-filter.ts` docblock, `search-conformance` ledger row) must be made consistent — that reconciliation is tracked in #7647.

**Cross-cutting:** #7641 and #7643 share the same `$contains`-case root (`#6518`); #7643 is cross-linked to #7641 in its body. One decision resolves both behaviours plus the three stale declarations.

Provenance: maintainer standing rule that every QA problem becomes an issue; run records close at extraction, same exit as #7514/#7463.
